shared_elements: repeated linear/comb-like marks in a row
schematic reduction of figures to outline forms
justification: A shows a low-relief pillar with an animal (apparently a quadruped/predator descending) and a rounded head-like protrusion, with incised chevron/finger-like ridges, while B shows a painted ship with a long crewed hull, upturned spiral prow and stern, plus a small profile quadruped above. The only real correspondences are the generic presence of a schematic profile animal and repeated short parallel strokes; the boat and its crew-stroke convention, and the relief-carved pillar imagery, have no counterpart in each other.
